rule.pork.name: Naman alade
rule.pork.why: Alade da dukkan sinadaran da aka samo daga alade haramun ne bisa dukkan ma’aunan halal da aka amince da su.
rule.porkDerived.name: {item} daga alade
rule.porkDerived.why: An bayyana cewa sinadarin ya fito daga alade, don haka ba halal ba ne.
rule.blood.name: Jini
rule.blood.why: Jini a matsayin sinadarin abinci haramun ne bisa ma’aunan halal da aka amince da su.
rule.alcoholic_beverage.name: Abin sha mai giya
rule.alcoholic_beverage.why: Barasa irin su ruwan inabi (wine), giya (beer) da makamantansu ba a yarda da su a matsayin sinadarai bisa ma’aunan da aka yi amfani da su. Akwai muhawara ko abin da ya rage bayan dafawa yana da hukunci daban; manhajar tana ɗaukar sinadarin da aka ambata a fili a matsayin haramun don taka-tsantsan.
rule.alcohol_declared.name: Barasa (ethanol)
rule.alcohol_declared.why: An ambaci barasa a fili a matsayin sinadari. Bisa ma’aunan da aka yi amfani da su, barasar da aka ƙara ba halal ba ce. Wasu ma’auni suna yarda da ɗan ƙaramin adadi na fasaha – ba za a iya duba wannan a nan ba.
rule.alcohol_free_beverage.name: Giya/ruwan inabi mara barasa
rule.alcohol_free_beverage.why: Giya da ruwan inabi marasa barasa na iya ɗauke da sauran barasa kuma ana yin su daga abubuwan sha masu barasa. Ra’ayoyi sun bambanta.
rule.wine_vinegar.name: Vinegar na ruwan inabi ko balsamic
rule.wine_vinegar.why: Malamai da yawa suna ganin vinegar da aka yi daga ruwan inabi ya halatta bayan ya canza gaba ɗaya, wasu kuma ba haka ba. Saboda haka ana nuna shi a matsayin wanda ba a bayyana ba.
rule.gelatine.name: Gelatin/collagen
rule.gelatine.why: Ana yin gelatin da collagen daga fata ko ƙasusuwan dabbobi (galibi alade ko saniya) ko daga kifi. Ba tare da sanin irin dabbar da yadda aka yanka ta ba, ba za a iya rarrabawa ba.
rule.rennet.name: Rennet/enzymes
rule.rennet.why: Rennet da enzymes na iya fitowa daga dabba (misali cikin ɗan maraƙi), ƙananan halittu ko tsirrai. Ba a ambaci asalin ba.
rule.cheese.name: Cuku
rule.cheese.why: Ana yawan yin cuku da rennet daga dabba. Ba a ambaci irin rennet ɗin ba.
rule.meat.name: Nama (yanka ko irin dabba ba a bayyana ba)
rule.meat.why: Naman dabbobin da aka halatta halal ne kawai idan an yanka su bisa shari’ar Musulunci. Ba za a iya tabbatar da hakan daga jerin sinadarai ba. A cikin tsiran nama (sausage), ham, bacon ko salami sau da yawa ma ba a ambaci irin dabbar ba.
rule.animal_fat.name: Kitsen dabba
rule.animal_fat.why: Kitsen dabba (misali kitsen saniya, kitsen alade) na iya fitowa daga alade ko daga dabbobin da ba a yanka su bisa shari’a ba. Ba a ambaci asalin ba.
rule.flavouring.name: Ɗanɗano (flavouring)
rule.flavouring.why: Ɗanɗano na iya ɗauke da abubuwa daga dabba ko barasa a matsayin mai narkarwa ko mai ɗauka. Ba wajibi ba ne ga masu yin kaya su bayyana hakan gaba ɗaya.
rule.e_number_animal_possible.name: Ƙarin sinadari da ka iya fitowa daga dabba
rule.e_number_animal_possible.why: Abubuwa kamar E471 (mono- da diglycerides), glycerol, stearates, polysorbates ko L-cysteine (E920) ana iya yin su daga tsirrai, ta hanyar kimiyya ko daga dabbobi. Ba tare da asalin ba, ba za a iya rarrabawa ba.
rule.bone_phosphate.name: Phosphate na ƙashi (E542)
rule.bone_phosphate.why: Ana yin sa daga ƙasusuwan dabbobi. Ba a ambaci irin dabba da yanka ba.
rule.insect_derived.name: Sinadari daga ƙwari
rule.insect_derived.why: Abubuwan da aka samo daga ƙwari (misali carmine E120, shellac E904) malamai da ma’aunan halal suna da ra’ayi daban-daban a kansu.
rule.seafood_non_fish.name: Abincin teku (ba kifi ba)
rule.seafood_non_fish.why: Jatan lande (shrimp), kawa, squid da makamantansu suna da hukunci daban bisa mazhaba, musamman a mazhabar Hanafi.
rule.whey.name: Whey (ruwan cuku)
rule.whey.why: Whey ragowa ne daga yin cuku. Wasu ma’aunan halal suna duba asalin rennet. Wannan bayani ba ya canza sakamakon.

ocr.tips.body:
• Haske mai kyau, ba walƙiya
• Riƙe waya daidai da fakitin
• Dole ne dukkan jerin ya bayyana, har da taken “Sinadarai”
• A yanzu rubutun Latin (Boko) kawai ake gane wa

info.rules.title: Yadda manhajar ke dubawa
info.rules.body:
1. Barcode yana gane kayan. Ana loda bayanai daga Open Food Facts – don wannan barcode daidai kawai. Open Food Facts rumbun bayanai ne na kyauta, ba hukumar bayar da takardar shaida ba.

2. Ana raba jerin sinadarai zuwa sinadarai ɗaiɗai (har da ƙananan sinadarai) a kwatanta su da jerin ƙa’idoji tabbatacce mai siga. Babu wata AI da ke yanke hukunci.

3. Ga kowane sinadari mai muhimmanci, manhajar tana bincike ta atomatik: asalin abu da lambar E, bayanan sinadarai na kaya a tsari, bayanan asali a cikin jerin (misali “daga tsirrai”), alamun fakiti (vegan/vegetarian), bayanan gaba ɗaya na abu daga rarrabuwar Open Food Facts da hanyoyin mai yin kaya da ake da su. Ana ɗaukar tambaya a matsayin wadda ta bayyana ne kawai idan akwai bayani game da wannan kaya daidai. Bayanan gaba ɗaya da bayanan masu amfani ba sa taɓa bayyana komai.

4. Sakamako:
• JA – HARAMUN: an ambaci sinadarin da aka haramta a fili (misali alade, gelatin na alade, jini, ruwan inabi, barasa).
• RUWAN LEMU – BA A BAYYANA BA: ba a iya tabbatar da asalin sinadari ba duk da bincike (misali gelatin ba tare da bayani ba, ɗanɗano, E471, rennet, nama ba tare da bayanin halal ba) ko akwai saɓani tsakanin malamai (misali carmine, vinegar na ruwan inabi, abincin teku).
• TOKA-TOKA – BA A TABBATAR BA: kayan, cikakken jerin sinadarai ko wani muhimmin bayani ba ya nan, bai cika ba, yana da saɓani, hoto ne kawai ko an rubuta da hannu.
• KORE – HALAL BISA CIKAKKEN BINCIKEN SINADARAI: sai idan dukkan sharuɗɗan amincewa sun cika (jerin dubawa a cikin sakamakon). Wannan ba takardar shaida ba ce kuma ba tabbaci ba ne.
• YANA DA TAKARDAR SHAIDAR HALAL yana bayyana ne kawai da takardar shaida da aka tabbatar mai inganci don wannan kaya daidai. A yanzu ba a haɗa wata majiyar takardun shaida ta kyauta da za a iya tabbatarwa ba.

Bayanin da ba a samu ba ba a taɓa ɗaukarsa halal ba.

Muhimmi: waɗannan ƙa’idoji aiwatarwa ce ta fasaha ta ƙa’idodi masu taka-tsantsan da aka fi bi. Malaman addinin Musulunci ba su duba su ba tukuna. Idan akwai shakka, tambayi wanda ke da ilimin addini.
info.privacy.title: Sirri
info.privacy.body:
• Babu rajista, babu asusu, babu talla, babu kayan aikin bincike.
• Lokacin dubawa, lambar barcode kawai ake aika wa Open Food Facts (world.openfoodfacts.org); don binciken sinadarai har ma da lambobin gane abubuwa na gaba ɗaya (misali “en:e471”) – babu bayanan sirri, sai don samun bayanan kaya. Kamar kowane haɗin intanet, sabar tana ganin adireshin IP ɗinka.
• Ana loda hotunan kaya kai tsaye daga Open Food Facts.
• Hotunan jerin sinadarai ana sarrafa su a wayarka kawai kuma ana goge su nan take bayan haka.
• Sai idan kai da kanka ka shigar da maɓallin USDA kuma Open Food Facts ba ta da jerin sinadarai: ana aika lambar barcode da maɓallinka zuwa USDA FoodData Central (api.nal.usda.gov, Amurka). Ana adana maɓallin a ɓoye a cikin ma’ajiyar tsaro ta wayarka.
• Ana adana tarihi, waɗanda aka fi so da saituna a wayarka kawai. Kana iya goge su a kowane lokaci a saituna ko ta cire manhajar.
• Kyamara: ana amfani da ita ne kawai don dubawa da ɗaukar hoto.

Manufar sirri ta Open Food Facts: https://world.openfoodfacts.org/privacy
info.sources.title: Majiyoyin bayanai da lasisi
info.sources.body:
Bayanan kaya: Open Food Facts – rumbun bayanai na kyauta da ake kula da shi tare. Rumbun bayanai yana ƙarƙashin Open Database License (ODbL), abubuwa ɗaiɗai ƙarƙashin Database Contents License, hotunan kaya ƙarƙashin Creative Commons BY-SA. Masu aikin sa-kai ne ke shigar da bayanan kuma suna iya zama ba cikakku ba ko tsofaffi. Kana iya gyara kurakurai kai tsaye a openfoodfacts.org.

Gane barcode: mobile_scanner (BSD-3-Clause) tare da Google ML Kit (Android) ko Apple Vision (iPhone).
Gane rubutu: Google ML Kit Text Recognition – yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba a kan na’ura.

Neman kaya da suna/alama: Open Food Facts (Search-a-licious), lasisi ɗaya.
Ƙarin jerin sinadarai (don GTIN ɗaya daidai kawai, idan an saita): USDA FoodData Central – mallakar jama’a (CC0 1.0), bayanan masu yin kaya don kasuwar Amurka.
Asalin abu (CID, CAS): PubChem (NCBI) – bayanan gaba ɗaya, ba shaidar asali ba.

Takardun shaidar halal: a yanzu ba a haɗa wani rumbun bayanai na takardun shaida na kyauta da za a iya tabbatarwa ba. Ana nuna alamun halal daga Open Food Facts amma ba a ɗaukarsu takardun shaida.

Lambar tushe: github.com/koray26/halal-scanner

unknown.languageMismatch: Bisa rumbun bayanai, harshen jerin sinadarai bai dace da harshen da aka bayyana ba. Wataƙila bayanan ba daidai ba ne.
unknown.ingredientsMostlyUnrecognized: Rumbun bayanai bai iya gane yawancin sinadarai ba. Wataƙila an rubuta jerin ba daidai ba.
unknown.labelContradiction: Alamar fakiti (misali “vegan”) tana saɓawa da wani sinadari. Bayanan suna da saɓani.
unknown.researchSourceUnavailable: Ba a iya isa ga wata majiyar bincike ba (misali babu intanet). Ba a yi wannan dubawa ba – don Allah “Sake dubawa” daga baya.
unknown.unsupportedScript: An rubuta jerin sinadarai gaba ɗaya ko galibi da rubutun da manhajar ba za ta iya kimantawa ba. A yanzu jerin sinadarai da aka rubuta da haruffan Latin (Boko) kawai ake dubawa.
ocr.unsupportedScript: Rubutun da aka gane bai yi kama da rubutun Latin ba. Gane rubutu a yanzu yana goyon bayan rubutun Latin kawai – don Allah duba ka gyara rubutun ko ka rubuta shi. Ta wannan hanyar ba za a iya samun amincewar kore ba.
substance.pork.identity: Abu daga alade (nama, kitse, fata ko abubuwan da aka samo daga gare su).
substance.alcoholic_beverage.identity: Abin sha da aka yi ta hanyar tsimi (da wataƙila tacewa) wanda ke ɗauke da ethanol, misali ruwan inabi, giya, barasa mai ƙarfi.
substance.alcohol_declared.identity: Ethanol (barasar sha) – an fayyace shi a fili ta kimiyya. Galibi ba a ambaci asalin kayan farko ba.
substance.alcohol_free_beverage.identity: Giya ko ruwan inabi da aka cire yawancin barasarsa. “Babu barasa” na iya nufin ɗan ƙaramin ragowa dangane da ƙasa (a Jamus galibi har zuwa 0.5 % na yawa).
substance.wine_vinegar.identity: Vinegar da aka yi daga ruwan inabi ta tsimin acetic; yawancin barasar tana canzawa zuwa acetic acid.
substance.gelatine.identity: Furotin daga collagen, wanda ake samu daga fata, ƙasusuwa ko jijiyoyin dabbobi (galibi alade ko saniya) ko daga kifi. Ba kullum ake ambaton irin dabbar a cikin jerin sinadarai ba.
substance.rennet.identity: Haɗin enzymes (galibi chymosin) don sa madara ta daskare. Yana iya fitowa daga cikin ɗan maraƙi, ƙananan halittu ko tsirrai.
substance.cheese.identity: Ana yin sa daga madara; ana yawan amfani da rennet daga dabba ko ƙananan halittu don daskarewa.
substance.meat.identity: Nama ko kayan nama. Ba kullum ake ambaton irin dabba ba, yadda aka yanka kusan ba a taɓa ambata ba.
substance.animal_fat.identity: Kitse daga jikin dabba, misali kitsen saniya (tallow) ko kitsen alade (lard) ko na agwagwa.
substance.flavouring.identity: Sunan gaba ɗaya na abubuwan da ke ba da ƙamshi ko ɗanɗano. Bisa dokar EU, galibi ba wajibi ba ne a lissafa abubuwan ɗanɗano ɗaiɗai da masu ɗauka (misali ethanol).
substance.e_number_animal_possible.ident: Ƙarin sinadari mai sanannen asalin kimiyya wanda za a iya yin sa daga kayan farko na tsirrai ko na dabba, ko ta hanyar kimiyya. Ba wajibi ba ne a ambaci asalin kayan farko.
substance.bone_phosphate.identity: Calcium phosphate da aka samo daga ƙasusuwan dabbobi.
substance.insect_derived.identity: Abu daga ƙwari, misali carmine daga ƙwarin cochineal ko shellac daga ruwan da ƙwarin lac ke fitarwa.
substance.seafood_non_fish.identity: Dabbobin teku masu ɓawo ko masu laushin jiki, misali jatan lande, kawa ko squid.
substance.whey.identity: Ruwan da ke fitowa lokacin yin cuku ko cuku mai laushi (quark).

usdaKey.status.none: Ba a saita ba – manhajar tana aiki ba tare da shi ba.
usdaKey.status.set: An saita – an adana a wannan na’ura kawai.
usdaKey.status.rejected: USDA ta ƙi – don Allah duba ko canza maɓallin.
usdaKey.body: Da maɓallinka na kyauta daga api.data.gov, manhajar tana ƙara tambayar USDA FoodData Central (Amurka) – amma sai idan Open Food Facts ba ta da jerin sinadarai, kuma don barcode ɗaya daidai kawai. Ba tare da maɓalli ba, wannan ƙarin majiya kawai ce ba ta nan; komai yana aiki kamar yadda yake. Babu wani maɓalli a cikin manhajar kanta.
usdaKey.label: Maɓallin kai
usdaKey.replace: Shigar da sabon maɓalli (zai maye gurbin tsohon)
usdaKey.privacy: Ana adana maɓallin a ɓoye a cikin ma’ajiyar tsaro ta wannan na’ura (iPhone: Keychain, Android: Keystore), ba a taɓa nuna shi ba, ba a adana shi a tarihi ba, kuma ana aika shi ne kawai zuwa api.nal.usda.gov – a cikin kan buƙatar, ba a cikin adireshi ba. Kada ka ba kowa shi.
usdaKey.removed: An goge maɓalli. Ba za a ƙara tambayar USDA ba.
usdaKey.error.format: Wannan bai yi kama da maɓalli mai inganci ba (haruffa da lambobi kawai, ba tare da tazara ba).
usdaKey.error.storage: Ma’ajiyar tsaro ta na’urar ba ta samuwa. Ba a adana maɓallin ba.
